chapters.title: The locust plague
chapters.summary: A devastating locust swarm has stripped the land. Joel calls priests and people to mourn, fast and cry out to the Lord.

chapters.title: Rend your heart
chapters.summary: The day of the Lord comes like an army. Rend your heart and not your garments, for God is gracious. He will restore the years the locust has eaten and pour out His Spirit on all flesh.

chapters.title: The valley of decision
chapters.summary: God will judge the nations in the valley of decision and be a refuge for His people. The mountains will drip with new wine, and God dwells in Zion.
